preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1,000,000.
The maximum weight of an edge m must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b
preconditions.description: Vertices a and b must be distinct and within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of beautiful trees modulo 1,000,000,007.
